text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Create version PR with Changesets
        uses: changesets/action@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish: false
          version: true
          title: "Version Packages"
          setupGitUser: true
          prDraft: false
          commit: true
          branch: main
```
